notes.title: Early Access Major Update #2 - Coups d’État
notes.content: [h1]A happy [i]Coups D'État[/i] to you![/h1][p][/p][p]A Coup D’état is a forceful change from the top through sudden overthrow (and a reliable way to end a revolution!) With that in mind, our latest update [b]Coups D'État[/b] is inspired by the famous Coup of 18 Brumaire against the French Directory which paved the way for Napoleon's ascent to power. With many new additions - including the official epic conclusion of the game - we excited to push this update out![/p][p][/p][h3]With this update you will find the following:[/h3][list][*][p]Part III campaign events, battles, and THE EPIC CONCLUSION OF THE GAME![/p][/*][*][p]NEW Trial instances[/p][/*][*][p]NEW Addition of sounds effects[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Just a reminder[/b]: your old saves will work with the new update BUT if you want full functionality, a new start is recommended.[/p][p][/p][p]We would love to know any feedback you have for us around these updates and the game. Your comments & questions are always greatly appreciated by the team![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who took the time to send feedback after the last update, including any bugs! Reminder that if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by pressing the F1 key.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking to meet fellow revolutionaries? [url="https://discord.gg/BqQQmSey" style="button"]We also have a Discord, come join us![/url]  Our Discord also has a dedicated bug channel for reporting and one-on-one support.[/p][p][/p][h3]We notes.title: Early Access major update #1 - King's Trial
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Everyone, happy storming of the Bastille day![/h1][p]
[i]July 14, 1789 The people of Paris seized the Bastille, the royal prison and symbol of royal arbitrariness. This came after days of riots fueled by the economic crisis and the dismissal of Jacques Necker, Louis XVI's finance minister. The insurgents searched for gunpowder and ammunition. In front of the Bastille, after hours of tension and negotiations with the governor, the crowd stormed the fortress. The Bastille fell, a symbolic victory for the people of Paris. The fall of the Bastille marked the beginning of the French Revolution. This day became a symbol of the popular uprising against absolutism. A year later, on July 14, 1790, the Republic organized the Fête de la Fédération (Fédération Festival).[/i]
[/p][h3]Developpement has been going strong on our end and with this, we present to you v0.15.2.4-RC, the King’s Trial update! notes.title: Summer Sale & Early Access 'King's Trial' update sneak peek
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][h1]STEAM SUMMER SALE[/h1][p]
The Steam summer sale is upon us, from now until July 10th, and Bonaparte is taking part with a -10% discount.[/p][p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/7b65ec0b3b03e6ef3b3b03deb6bee836f2a4838c.png"][/img][/h1][p][/p][h1]"KING'S TRIAL" UPCOMING UPDATE[/h1][p]
Meanwhile, the team is busy working on the upcoming "King's Trials" Early Access update that is planned to go live later this summer![/p][p]This update will introduce a new 'Trials' feature that will conclude major narrative events that are turning points in your rewriting of the revolution! The King's escape will now be concluded by a trial and the fate of the King will be decided democratically. As for votes in the National Convention, you will be able to slightly influence the trial's outcome by swaying some of the votes through diplomacy or bribery.

Here is a sneak peek of the Trial's screen in action:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/12df557930745c7748126fd42502652d023dc172.gif"][/img][/p][p]The update will also introduce many improvements accross the board, most notably to tactical battles. We will share more about the update very soon so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Patch Update v0.15.0.0-RC4 + Updated List of Known Issues
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone! [/h2]

Our team has been working hard to address several issues and make Bonaparte - A Mechanized Revolution run as smooth as possible, and with that, v0.15.0.0-RC4 is now live! This build addresses several issues including a bug where officers will occasionally disappear from the game on load and tactical combat refuses to end when too many units are present on the map, resulting in the game to softlock.

A big thank you to everyone who has reported bugs to use, and a reminder that if you are experiencing a bug, you can report it in-game by pressing the F1 key while in-game. Our [url=https://discord.com/invite/bonapartegame]Discord[/url] also has a dedicated bug channel for more in-depth, one-on-one support. 

You can check out the patch notes for v0.15.0.0-RC4 below, as well as our updated list of known issues! 

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed unit portraits going outside their bounds on the garrison UI screen.
[*] Made the Retry button purple to differentiate it from Continue at the end of combat.
[*] Fixed tactical combat refusing to end when too many units are present on the map, softlocking the game.
[*] Fixed bug where officers will occasionally disappear from the game on load.
[/list]
[h2]List of Known Issues[/h2]

[h3]Languages[/h3]
[list]
[*] At 1.0 launch, the game will include Chinese(simplified), Chinese(Traditional), Japanese and Korean, but these will not be present in Early Access.
[/list]
[h3]Resolution[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ultrawide resolutions are not currently supported. Please switch to 16:9 through the options.
[/list]
[h3]Game Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some tactical units (Skirmishers, Dragoons) are more powerful than other units.
[*] Most rebel controlled regions only have two possible army compositions.
[*] Tactical AI units tend to be aggressive and don’t use many abilities.
[/list]
[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game is currently missing a key to swap the facing direction of a tactical unit.
[/list]
[h3]Dialogue[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some of the dialogue, in particular when buildings are constructed/demolished/upgraded or units are recruited, is very repetitive and unnecessary.
[*] There are several typos in the dialogue that will be addressed before launch.
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some of the 3D visuals are still being polished, such as the houses in the combat maps.
[*] There are some cluttered text popups, particularly during combat sequences.
[*] The army movement arrow can clip through units and gizmos.
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some sound effects remain to be added into the game, for example in the National Convention.
[/list]
[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various panels in the game are still undergoing interface polish. This includes:
[list]
[*] All recruitment panels (Battalion, Colossus, and Officer)
[*] Many of the smaller pop up panels
[*] The save/load panel
[*] There may also be small layout/formatting issues on various panels as well
[/list] [/list]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] While the team is rapidly fixing bugs, several open notable bugs are:
[list]
[*] After completing a defensive tactical battle, the prisoner UI will be shown but the turn will continue to play out in the background.
[*] The first mention of a coup in the narrative happens one turn too early.
[*] Sometimes, the automatic zoom will zoom too closely to the ground in tactical combat.
[*] The camera will lock on units during the end of turn phase even if the unit does not take any actions, resulting in a rapid, jerky movement.
[*] Occasionally, incorrect officer portraits may be shown when performing certain actions on the strategic map.,
[*] Trampling through the first peasant unit in the Bastille battle can sequence break the tutorial.
[*] AI can sometimes construct a mech and attack in the same turn.
[*] Defense battles will start in fast motion if the player enters one while speed is set to fast forward.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: This XCOM-style strategy game dares to ask: What if Napoleon Bonaparte was a woman who had an army of battlemechs?
notes.content: The French Revolution was a time of overwhelming and quotidian violence. As Louis Antoine de Saint-Just—the revolution's Angel of Death himself—put it in Georg Büchner's play Danton's Death, "Is it so remarkable that the stream of the revolution should at every bend and cataract cast up its corpses? … Are a few hundred dead bodies to hold us back? Moses led his people through the Red Sea and into the wilderness till the old corrupt generation was exterminated… Legislators! We have no Red Sea and no wilderness, but we have war and the guillotine!".. Read more.

[*] There are several typos in the dialogue that will be addressed before launch.
[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some of the 3D visuals are still being polished, such as the houses in the combat maps.
[*] There are some cluttered text popups, particularly during combat sequences.
[*] The army movement arrow can clip through units and gizmos.
[*] Unit portrait images can occasionally extend beyond their boundaries
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] Some sound effects remain to be added into the game, for example in the National Convention.
[/list]
[h3]Interface[/h3]
[list] 
[*] Various panels in the game are still undergoing interface polish. This includes:
[list]
[*] All recruitment panels (Battalion, Colossus, and Officer)
[*] Many of the smaller pop up panels
[*] The save/load panel
[*] Some panels, such as the negotiation panel in the clubs, need to be aligned better
[*] There may also be small layout/formatting issues on various panels as well
[/list] [/list]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] While the team is rapidly fixing bugs, several open notable bugs are:
[list]
[*] After completing a defensive tactical battle, the prisoner UI will be shown but the turn will continue to play out in the background.
[*] The first mention of a coup in the narrative happens one turn too early.
[*] Sometimes, the automatic zoom will zoom too closely to the ground in tactical combat.
[*] The camera will lock on units during the end of turn phase even if the unit does not take any actions, resulting in a rapid, jerky movement.
[*] Occasionally, incorrect officer portraits may be shown when performing certain actions on the strategic map.
[*] Trampling through the first peasant unit in the Bastille battle can sequence break the tutorial.
[*] AI can sometimes construct a mech and attack in the same turn.
[*] Defense battles will start in fast motion if the player enters one while speed is set to fast forward.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Update #2 - December 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Happy end of year celebrations![/h1]

[h3]On behalf of the whole Studio Imugi team, we would like to wish you the best end of year celebrations. This has been a particularly troubled period for the game industry, and as we reflect on these past few months, we realize that we have been lucky to withstand the storm when so many of our fellow game devs have been critically impacted by the numerous layoffs. We hope that this end of year break will allow them to enjoy quality time with friends and family, and for the new year to be full of opportunities and successes.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png[/img]

[h3]As part of our development process, the whole team sat down to reflect on the past months and how the game has evolved since January. Here is a brief recap of our key 2024 milestones:[/h3]

[h1]GAME REVEAL:[/h1]
Jongwoo, Etienne and Martin travelled all the way to Köln, Germany, to attend Gamescom and introduce Bonaparte to the gaming press. We had a pretty neat booth, and a fully packed agenda with over 80 individual meetings! Our passion for this project was definitely conveyed with many positive previews: PCGamesN defines Bonaparte as [i]“a visionary mix of Civilization, Crusader Kings, and… Armored Core”.[/i] We couldn't agree more :3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/9f1362de8815a1e620013b4b7d7d5afc66f9218f.jpg[/img]

If you haven't already, please consider wishlisting Bonaparte and don't miss out on future news & announcements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560340/Bonaparte__A_Mechanized_Revolution/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png[/img]

[h1]STEAM NEXT FEST:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/181e720a38fbac826aee7b1275dad3ef3287f3b0.gif[/img]
We participated in the Steam Next Fest in October and crafted a custom demo for the occasion. If you haven't found the time to check it out yet, the demo is still available to play. Head over the steam page and hit that download button :)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2560340/Bonaparte__A_Mechanized_Revolution/ style=button]Play the demo[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png[/img]

[h1]INSIDER INITIATIVE:[/h1] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/92f6d468892cab6e6ade829908a9a0e0225b8cfa.png[/img]
After engaging early this year with a tight group of strategy veteran players, we have finally kickstarted our insider initiative in November. We strongly believe that engaging with players early in the development process can help our team craft the best game we can. 

We now have monthly dev builds available to test, and dedicated Discord channels where insiders can voice their opinions, share feedback & ideas, directly with the team.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/bonapartegame style=button]Join us & make your voice count![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png[/img]

[h1]ANNUAL DEVELOPMENT REVIEW:[/h1]
The game has progressed A LOT this year, thanks to the amazing work of our (tiny) team. From visuals to gameplay features, bug fixes, balancing, narration, music & audio, here is a brief look at 2024 major developments:

[list]

[*] We have completed the design and visuals of our strategic map. With the help of our Historian, we have invested a lot in making sure our late 18th century map of France was as authentic as possible. As shown below, it now includes the proper [i]regions/départements[/i] segmentation, refined visuals, and many usability improvements (to better see the control of different factions, the population support, or the location of other squads & armies). Interactions on the strategic map have also been dramatically improved, from army movement to district management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/451a0219f3270fe00295f52724fe38b9741ff798.gif[/img]

[*] A lot of effort was also spent on improving our tactical battles. We have built and keep iterating on tools that allow us to create new battle arenas, and generally pushed visual quality across the board with better rendering, animations and particles, that make our arenas a lot livelier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/9a52b9a97536cc821e8fadb1f04e3ffef6aa2755.gif[/img]

Aside from the map, the visual quality has also been pushed on the units and the attack resolutions. The animations and textures for our 2D units as well as user interface elements have been drastically improved, and we started integrating special effects, and audio cues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/f65f904a8c7e819a7e5c08fa30124b7f4fe3162a.gif[/img]

Actual tactical features were also developed and implemented, such as the morale/heat system and the various unit abilities (such as the Colossi 'intimidation', or the cavalry 'trample' charge below).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/7a100bdd3b1ab908116ce4e577e269339c3fe32e.gif[/img]

[*] We implemented new historical figures to the game, each with its own 2D portrait and particular political alignment, that player can interact with. As well as many new illustrations for the different game screens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/75b11bb23c87a4f2804fe9ef63f0c872565b0129.gif[/img]

[*] We expanded our political gameplay with the National Convention system that allows players to gain power, participating in elections and submitting reforms to be voted on. The game simulates population classes (the masses, bourgeoisie, and clergy) and player choices now directly impact political standing, and available options on the strategic map through negotiation, military actions, or propaganda.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/6db72f9b54eb8a08555bc600d07c0139b6d95a7b.gif[/img]

[*] And a ton of behind the scenes work to support development moving forward (such as an autosave feature, bug fixes, balancing, etc...).

[/list]

The team will stay busy until we launch Bonaparte in Early Access later next year in 2025. And we have planned to add most of our narrative content, while improving our existing systems and implementing more content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/80b7549799abdd96c15547db0be559c6857ecb87.jpg[/img]
[i]- the Studio Imugi team[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/dd96068317fd0239e68ee01ec72746f62be56d9a.png[/img]

Thanks for checking out our annual review! Our team is excited to launch Bonaparte in Early Access later next year in 2025. Until then, we'll be busy working on improvements to the National Convention, adding new battle biomes, as well as writing and integrating new narrative content for the campaign.

[h2]Happy holidays![/h2]

notes.title: Turn-based strategy game Bonaparte wants to redo the French Revolution, but this time with mechs
notes.content:
Everything I know about the French Revolution has hitherto come from two literary works: Hilary Mantel's excellent doorstopper A Place Of Greater Safety, and Kate Beaton's webcomics. Neither Mantel nor Beaton mention mechs, which are a core feature of Studio Imugi's new "ideology driven" turn-based strategy game Bonaparte: A Mechanized Revolution. I, for one, feel like I've been grossly ill-informed. Kate, Hilary - I've been quoting you for years at parties and it seems like all this time, people have been silently judging me for my ignorance of the role giant clockwork soldiers played in the fall of the Bastille.

Read more

notes.title: Announcing Bonaparte - A Mechanized Revolution
notes.content:
Today we are super proud to reveal our debut title, Bonaparte - A Mechanized Revolution, as part of the Gamescom "Find Your Next Game" showcase organized by Gamestar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162036/7af1452e7ba1ea7c8eb957a32a2ab78f3fb7685f.jpg[/img]

Rewrite history as you play as an alternate reimagining of the historical figure Bonaparte, and work to defend, overthrow or reform a collapsing monarchy in an alternate version of the French Revolution in this ideology-driven, turn-based, tactical / strategy mashup. Choose your ideals and take control of France by any means necessary, reshaping her future to match your vision. Joining the political fray in this adaptive alternate history game are famous historical characters and factions, creating a political theater in which tensions and conflicts never play out the same way. 

The game features epic battles where gunpowder clashes with steam-powered mechs, known as Colossi, tense tactical turn-based combat rewards valor and cunning over brute strength. Bonaparte’s presentation of alternate history is accentuated by its unique approach to the strategy genre: mirroring the consequences of political action, players can see policy play out in real time on the battlefield.
